about:
Axial Industries Ltd. is a bearing supplier headquartered in Iowa City, Iowa. The company has been sourcing and supplying bearings and related products for more than 30 years, growing into a leading distributor for the agricultural and industrial manufacturing markets.

The company distributes a full line of bearings — including AG disk harrow bearings, taper roller bearings, mounted units, needle roller bearings, water pump bearings, stamped flanges, double row ball bearings, radial ball bearings, angular contact bearings, oil seals, sprockets and pulleys — sourced from premium and value brands worldwide. Axial also offers machining, extrusion and die‑casting capabilities, and operates flexible delivery, stocking and warehousing programs from its Iowa facility. A dedicated office in China supports global supplier qualification and product identification.

Axial serves customers across automotive and transportation, agriculture and construction, energy and utilities, industrial machinery and automation, defense and marine, mining and metals, medical and pharmaceutical, and food and beverage sectors. Its clientele ranges from OEMs to maintenance operations that require reliable bearing solutions to keep production lines running.

The company emphasizes responsive, knowledgeable service — every inquiry reaches a specialist with decades of bearing experience — and maintains rigid quality standards to ensure shipments match exact specifications. Its stated goal is to eliminate sourcing headaches by delivering the right product on time, at competitive prices.
